messages:
alex: Heads-up: OpenSSL/libcrypto CVE chain for musl on Alpine showed up in our scanner. We need a remediation plan that doesn't break KMS signing or RBAC/audit flows. Anyone owning baseimage? 🧵
maria: @alex I'm happy to lead the rebuild. Quick q: are we patching alpine:3.18 -> 3.19 or applying OpenSSL vendor patch on 3.18?
samir: Patch upstream OpenSSL 3.1.2 is available. Alpine 3.18 has backports but we should avoid a full dist-upgrade for canary images. Suggest rebuilding minimal images with updated libssl and carrying a compat-shim for soname symlinks.
li: if we introduce a compat-shim, double-check KMS client (kms-agent) sig verification paths. The shim modifies /usr/lib/libcrypto.so -> different soname resolution. Could affect signer sidecars.
alex: Good point. @li can you run a quick lookup of kms client expected SONAMEs? I'll paste the path shortly.
li: ran quick lookup: kms-agent binary looks for libcrypto.so.1.1 and libssl.so.3 at startup. If we symlink, dynamic loader will resolve, but runtime TLS init differs. Risk: subtle regressions under high concurrency.
infra-bot: deploy/canary initiated by maria at 1763600300 for image: rwd/base:minimal-openssl-3.1.2-canary
maria: Canary plan: 10% service traffic to canary cluster for 4 hours, enable verbose audit logging (trace) for KMS ops, and strip nonessential layers to speed rollout. Rollback on any 5xx or signer errors.
samir: Add test matrix: run 1000 concurrent sign requests, KV cache warmups, and random RBAC user tokens. I'll run in load-test harness tonight and post results.
li: Also add: run `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/compat-fix.so` smoke tests (we'll build a small shim to normalize symbols) — don't preload in prod during canary unless we confirm.
alex: What about image signing? Need to re-attest new digest in KMS + update attestor allowlist? Any RBAC change required to let the signer read new layer paths? @maria
maria: No RBAC needed for reading images. But our image-attestor policy checks digest allowlists. We'll need a short-lived policy update: add canary digest to attestor allowlist for 6 hours. Ops will create PR and I'll notify security for audit trail.
samir: I'll instrument metrics: kms_sign_errors, signer_latency_p50/p95, image_attest_failures. If kms_sign_errors > 0.5% or attest_failures > 0 -> auto rollback.
alex: ok doc notes: https://rwd.internal/wiki/baseimage-openssl-patch (placeholder) — checklist: build, sign, attest, update canary allowlist, load test, monitor, rollback criteria.
li: small snag: FIPS-enabled endpoints may reject the new libssl if provider ABI changed. We need to test FIPS paths specifically. @alex can you coordinate with compliance to run FIPS cert matrix?
alex: on it, pinging compliance. Also log retention: increase audit logs to 30d for the canary traffic to aid forensics.
maria: action items: 1) samir: load tests (tonight). 2) li: compat-shim build + smoke tests. 3) alex: compliance + audit retention + attestor PR. 4) infra-bot: start canary at 1763600300. I'll capture results in the PR.
infra-bot: canary update: 50% traffic reached at 1763600580 (auto-scale). All basic probes ok.
samir: load test finished: 0.3% signer errors, p95 latency +45ms. Correlating with cache cold-start. No attest failures. Pushed logs to s3://rwd-temp/opentest/176360
li: smoke tests passed with shim disabled, but when enabling LD_PRELOAD some unit tests flake under threaded TLS. We'll push a revised shim to handle __tls_get_addr fix.
maria: decision: proceed with extended canary for 6 more hours, but enable attestor allowlist for canary digest. Alex please add audit tag to each KMS op (trace.kms.canary=openssl-3.1.2).
alex: done. added audit tag and increased retention. Notifying compliance.
compliance: Received. We'll watch for FIPS test outputs. No objection to extended canary.
maria: thanks everyone — will update PR with timeline and merge window for global rollout after pass. :thumbsup:
